# Copilot Instructions

## General Behavior
- Write minimal, production-ready code
- Avoid unnecessary refactoring
- Follow existing project structure strictly
- Do not introduce new patterns unless required

---

## Next.js Rules
- Use App Router conventions if present
- Prefer Server Components where possible
- Use Client Components only when necessary
- Keep UI in /components
- Keep logic in /lib, /utils, /services

---

## Node.js Backend Rules
- Use layered architecture:
- routes → controllers → services → repositories
- Controllers must not contain business logic
- Services handle all business logic
- Validate all inputs before processing

---

## React Rules
- Reuse components instead of creating duplicates
- Keep hooks reusable and isolated
- Avoid unnecessary re-renders
- Prefer functional components

---

## API Rules
- Always validate input (zod/yup/joi)
- Return consistent response formats
- Avoid raw queries in routes/controllers

---

## Database Rules
- Never drop or alter schema without explicit instruction
- Always use migrations
- Optimize queries and indexing

---

## Performance Rules
- Avoid full dataset loading
- Use pagination for APIs
- Minimize unnecessary computations

---

## Output Rules
- Only modify relevant files
- Keep responses concise
- Provide clean, ready-to-use code
